Name: 0_truck_finger_working_employee
Representative_Docs: ['An employee operating construction equipment ran off the road at a construction site and suffered broken bones.', 'An employee slipped on ice on the rig floor and put his hand out to break his fall. His finger was caught between the stump and the Kelly, tearing skin off the fingertip.', 'An employee was loading equipment onto a truck, standing on a lubricator rack/catwalk while releasing straps on a crane, when the catwalk collapsed. He fell about 5 feet to the truck below and hit his head.']

Name: 1_gas_nearby_area_valve
Representative_Docs: ['Gas testing was performed at the start of a hot work job but not repeated after a shift change several hours later.', "An employee and two vendor employees were repairing a tank dike liner with a heating iron. Flammable condensate had leaked from plumbing at a hammer union nearby. The heat gun ignited the vapors, causing third degree burns to the workers' hands.", 'Two employees were performing compression checks on cylinders. One opened the gas valve while the other bent over to light the starter. The gas flashed, engulfing an employee and causing second degree burns to his face, neck, wrist, and back.']

Name: 2_pipe_hand_line_continued
Representative_Docs: ['An employee was moving fluid from one end of a pit to the other, which required opening a metal grating hatch. While standing up, the hatch closed on his hand, amputating two fingertips.', 'An employee was closing a manhole cover in the floor of a mud pit when a disconnected 6-inch discharge line lying next to the cover shifted, pinching the end of his finger between the floor grating and the line. He suffered an amputation.', 'Two employees were observing a crew reconfiguring a wellhead when trapped pressure was released inside the well and blew shrapnel - nuts, bolts, and valve parts - at them. One employee suffered an amputation injury to his thumb.']

Name: 3_permit_signed_isolation_crew
Representative_Docs: ['Two workers entered a separator vessel for inspection without a signed entry permit, assuming it was a quick look.', 'Crew started wireline job without a signed permit to work; supervisor said it would be filled in after the job to save time.', "Vessel entry team entered a separator for inspection using the previous day's permit, which had already expired at shift change."]

Name: 4_repeated_pressure_shift_kept
Representative_Docs: ['Operator noticed the high-pressure trip kept nuisance-tripping the compressor and bypassed the interlock to keep production running through the shift.', 'Pipefitter opened a flange on a line believed to be isolated, but a bypass valve had not been closed, releasing residual product.', 'A pressure switch that kept nuisance-tripping the pump was wired around during a night shift to avoid repeated callouts.']

Name: 5_load_lift_crane_rated
Representative_Docs: ['A worker climbed onto equipment to gain height instead of using the available man-lift.', 'A crane operator lifted a load with the boom angle steeper than the load chart allowed, causing the load to swing.', 'Crane operator moved a load without a signed lift permit because the crew lead said they had done this move before.']

Name: 6_road_break_slid_broken
Representative_Docs: ['A driver failed to chain up in icy conditions on a mountain access road and slid off the shoulder.', 'An employee was driving down a lease road, struck a rock, over-corrected, and ran off the road into larger rocks that deployed the airbag. The employee suffered a possible concussion.', 'An employee was driving an ATV on a gas well access road. Going downhill, the rear end slipped on leaves and the ATV slid into a rut and flipped, throwing the employee off. He suffered a broken collarbone and three broken ribs.']
